title: Italian restaurants in Tel Aviv compared by hours, price range and menu
intro: This guide compares nine Italian restaurants listed on Google Maps for 'Italian restaurant in Tel Aviv' on 25 November 2026, excluding sponsored listings. Facts were taken from each restaurant's own website, menu PDF or public Instagram/booking page where one could be fetched, otherwise from the Google Maps listing; fields we could not verify are left empty. Prices are as published by the restaurants on the date checked and may change.

businesses.name: Altito
businesses.address: Azrieli Center, entrance from Menakhem Begin Rd 132, Tel Aviv
services: Italian: pizza, pasta, salads and wine (Instagram bio)
quick service: 'ready in 5 minutes' (Instagram bio)
online ordering via altito.co.il (BringIt ordering system)
businesses.licence: Kosher, stated as 'כשר בד״ץ' in the Instagram bio; certifying body not named
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪50–100; Instagram bio states 'from ₪45'
businesses.note: The website altito.co.il is an ordering-system page that did not render as text, so menu and hours could not be read from it; facts come from the Instagram bio and Google Maps.

businesses.name: Amore Mio
businesses.address: Shlomo Ibn Gabirol St 100, Tel Aviv
businesses.hours: Sun–Sat 12:00–00:30, kitchen open until 23:00 (website); business lunch Sun–Thu 12:00–17:00
services: pizza, pasta, ravioli, risotto, gnocchi, meat mains (menu PDF)
dishes based on central and southern Italian cooking (website)
reservations by phone only
delivery via Wolt and 10bis
self-pickup by phone
vegan and gluten-free options marked on the menu
businesses.since: opened 'more than 20 years ago' by Susanna and Shlomi Salomon (website)
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪100–150. Hebrew menu dated 8/2026: focaccia ₪32, pizza Margherita ₪74, pasta Pomodoro ₪68, Guy's Carbonara ₪88, gnocchi ₪85–89, tiramisu ₪52. English menu dated 5/2025: pizzas ₪72–79, pastas ₪61–89, risotto ₪87
businesses.note: Sister restaurant of the adjacent Pizza Pazza according to the restaurant's own site; the English menu online is older (May 2025) than the Hebrew one (Aug 2026).

businesses.name: Cafe Italia
services: Italian brasserie: fresh pasta made in-house from durum wheat and eggs, seafood, meat mains (website)
online reservations via Tabit and by phone
self-pickup orders via Tabit Order
business lunch menu
bar in the centre of the room (website)
whole-wheat or gluten-free pasta available for all pasta dishes
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪100–150. Website menu: focaccia ₪34, eggplant parmesan ₪54, pastas ₪78–98 (linguine arrabbiata ₪78, lasagna bolognese ₪88, seafood pasta ₪98), risotto ₪92–108, whole sea bass ₪142, osso buco ₪138, tiramisu ₪38, cocktails ₪52
businesses.note: The website names chef Itay Bidarman and the Yerzin brothers as the people behind the restaurant; no pizza section appears on the online menu.

businesses.name: Cicchetti
services: Italian small plates in the spirit of Venetian neighbourhood bars (website)
seasonal menu with local ingredients
sections: primi, verdura, crudo, forno (focaccia, pizzette), pasta, frutti di mare
online reservations via Ontopo and by phone/WhatsApp
brunch menu Fri–Sat
gift cards via BuyMe
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪100–200; the restaurant's online menu PDF lists dishes without prices
businesses.note: Website states the building is heritage-protected: accessible entrance but no accessible restroom. Google Maps closing time (22:30) matches the website.

businesses.name: Ernesto 90
services: traditional Italian cooking (website: 'the real Italian kitchen'), kitchen led by chef Angelo De La Riccia
reservations by phone only; callback contact form
large wooden terrace (website)
event planning section on the website
Italian music during meals (website)
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪100–150; the website menu is published as images without machine-readable prices
businesses.note: The website cites a five-page feature in the Italian magazine Famiglia Cristiana and admission to the guide of the Accademia Italiana della Cucina.

businesses.name: Kiosk Del Pasta
businesses.address: Shlomo Ibn Gabirol St 20, Tel Aviv
businesses.hours: Instagram bio: Sun–Wed 11:00–22:30, Thu 11:00–23:30, Fri 17:00–22:00, Sat 12:00–22:30; Google Maps (25 Nov 2026): closes 00:00
services: handmade fresh pasta 'with a twist of authentic flavours', wines and classic aperitifs (Ontopo page)
online reservations via Ontopo (link in Instagram bio)
weekday happy-hour discounts on alcohol and food; Sunday glass of wine ₪10 (Ontopo page)
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪50–100; no dish prices published on the pages fetched
businesses.note: No own website found; hours on Instagram, Ontopo and Google Maps differ, so confirm before visiting.

businesses.name: Lupa
businesses.hours: Google Maps (25 Nov 2026): open, closes 22:00; Instagram bio (truncated) lists Sun 8:00–17:00
services: 'Tavola Calda | מסעדנייה איטלקית' (Italian restaurant-deli, Instagram bio)
businesses.note: No own website; only an Instagram page. Google Maps gives the address as Barzilai St 3 (לבונטין 13), the Instagram bio as Levontin 13.

businesses.name: Magazzino
businesses.hours: Restaurant Sun–Wed and Sat 12:00–23:00, Thu–Fri 12:00–24:00; in-house konditoria daily 8:00–23:00 (website)
services: contemporary Italian menu: pizza, fresh pasta, starters, salads, mains, changing risotto (website + menu PDF)
online reservations via Tabit and by phone
delivery via Wolt, self-pickup via Tabit Order
two event spaces 'from intimate to large' with events menu (website)
happy hour 16:00–18:30 weekdays, 25% off the whole menu (menu PDF)
gluten-free pizza and pasta, vegan cheese on pizzas (menu PDF)
second branch: café-konditoria in Ramat Aviv
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪100–150. Menu PDF (Nov 2026): focaccia ₪32, starters ₪32–84, salads ₪58–72, pizzas ₪76–88 (Margherita ₪76), pastas ₪76–98 (fettuccine al limone ₪76, rigatoni bolognese ₪82, lasagna ₪88, Sicilian fish fettuccine ₪98), smash burger ₪94, cocktails ₪54–56
businesses.note: Menu PDF is in Hebrew with English section headers; the English site page links the same PDF.

businesses.name: olio
services: fresh pasta, pizza, wine and cocktails late into the night (website)
online table reservations and by phone
own delivery within 5 km, free over ₪190; pickup and curbside pickup
private events (birthdays, company events, closed evenings) and pasta trays for events, 48 hours' notice
gift cards ₪200–1,000
spicy dishes marked; allergy note on menu
businesses.prices: Google Maps price band ₪50–100. Website menu: focaccia ₪34, starters ₪34–65, pastas ₪62–69 (Pomodoro ₪62, Cacio e Pepe ₪65, Funghi e Tartufo ₪69), pizzas ₪65–69 (Margherita ₪65), desserts ₪49–55, cocktails ₪49
businesses.note: The only restaurant in this list whose published hours run until 04:00; Google Maps shows the same closing time.

sources: Google Maps listing data supplied for the nine restaurants, 25 November 2026
